- [LCNT.7.2] **Series and signals** offer windowed aggregations computed
  by incremental streaming backings — Welford, ring buffer, monotonic
  deque, FIFO deque, reservoir ([LSER.18.1]). The author declares what to
  compute and reads the result; the author gets no per-sample access, and
  never names a backing ([LSER.13.3]).
